reason: Feasibility/schedule lens: M3 survives, but only as a conditional gate edit, and it is worth about 0 unless K4 is actually built. (1) Cheap and safe. It changes no notebook code: only the pre-registered R7 text and a K4 branch in tools/dummy_gates.py, which already implements 'final nodes +-0.3% per clip' and 'readmit/gapfill +-10%' for K2 (l.113-121). So byte-identity when off and fail-soft do not apply. It costs 0 GPU and 0 LB slots (it can only remove a submission), and it adds no hidden-run time. The ~0.3 h effort is believable. Editing a gate before the K4 dummy exists is legitimate pre-registration. (2) The rider it gates does not exist. A grep for 'tempfuse' in tools/, tests/ and experiments/ at 17:50Z 25 Sep finds 0 hits: no build_probe_kernel patch and no exp61. The cloud session that was meant to build it ended after T1 (CONTEXT 14:05Z). Tonight's plan is research rounds only (CONTEXT 17:55Z). R10 cuts tempfuse first, and the v3 value verdict refuted it (central +0.0008). The window is still open. The 5 h build plus a CPU mock can run on this laptop (torch 2.13 CPU and tracksdata import OK). If it starts on 26 Sep by ~12:00Z, the dummy and TEMPFUSE=0 twin need ~1.4 GPU-h after the quota reset, the submit lands in S6/S7 before the 27 Sep 12:00Z R8 freeze, and the score arrives 7-10 h later. My guess is P(K4 built, gated and submitted) ~0.2-0.35, so M3's unconditional value is ~+0.0001. (3) Gaps in M3 as written. (a) It has no runtime gate. The '~4 h headroom' is against the 12 h limit, not against the insertion gate: step0.md puts K2 at <= ~7.8 h against DIVINS_DEADLINE_S 28,800 s (8.0 h), a worst-case margin of only ~720 s. Tempfuse's delayed edge loop, fused-map maxima and per-frame top-K sit in the GPU phase, before every repair. An overhead above ~7 s/clip x ~100 hidden clips would push the last clips' insertion past its gate (fail-soft, but it loses the +0.001 insertion). That loss is the same size as the node-drift loss M3 is trying to prevent. (b) The v3 top-K fix allows |K_fused-K| <= max(1,1%) per frame. A systematic +1 per frame would then fail the 0.3% final gate by construction. The clamp should be exact K, so raw nodes per clip equal the stack's. (c) 'vs the current F1 stack dummy' must mean a sha256-verified TEMPFUSE=0 twin of the same build (as K1/K2), or K3/K3b changes confound the comparison. (d) K2's 'LOWDET N == exp56' gate cannot carry over, because tempfuse redraws the lowdet pool from the fused map. The K4 gate list must say which K2 gates are replaced.
fix: Adopt M3 as a pre-registration edit only if someone commits to building K4 by 26 Sep 12:00Z. Otherwise record 'K4 dropped, S6 empty' and spend nothing. If K4 is built: (1) Set the top-K clamp to exact K. Gate: raw nodes per clip == the TEMPFUSE=0 twin. (2) Gate: final nodes within +-0.3% per clip and readmit/gapfill within +-10%, both vs a TEMPFUSE=0 twin whose CSV sha256 equals the stack dummy. (3) Add a RUNTIME gate: K4 dummy GPU-phase wall time (the 'Prediction completed in' line) <= twin + max(2%, 20 s), which is <= ~7 s/clip. Then recompute the step-0 forecast: T(N=106) + delta must stay <= 7.8 h so the 8.0 h insertion gate keeps >= 0.2 h. Fail if not. (4) Drop 'LOWDET N == exp56' for K4 and replace it with 'LOWDET N within +-10% of twin' plus per-frame peak IoU logged. Keep all hard-fail lines (REPAIR FAILED, DEADLINE:, DIVINS FAILED, LOWREFINE FAILED, TEMPFUSE FAILED). (5) Write the gate into CONTEXT/R7 and dummy_gates.py (--k4/--k4twin) BEFORE the exp61 dummy is pushed. Latest push ~27 Sep 06:00Z so the dummy plus gate check fits before the 12:00Z freeze.
realistic_gain: Conditional on K4 being built and gated: removes the ~-0.001 node-drift tail, E[K4] about +0.0003 -> +0.0005 public (the idea's own estimate; not re-derived here). With the added runtime gate it also protects the insertion (~+0.001 at risk in the worst-case timing tail). Unconditional, with P(K4 built and submitted) ~0.2-0.35 (a guess): ~+0.0001. It costs 0 GPU, 0 slots and ~0.3-0.5 agent-h.
